name: Main Shop
comment: All dimensions in FEET. X runs along the 105' length, Z along the 50' width, Y is up. The 'front' wall is at z=0. Left/right are always AS SEEN FROM OUTSIDE facing the wall in question - so the left end wall is at x=105.

openings.label: Ramp opening
openings.note: 9'-0" clear measured up from the top of the ramp; aligned with the ramp

obstructions.label: Cinderblock notch
obstructions.note: Walled to the roof - inaccessible, unusable space

ramps.label: Ramp to adjacent building
ramps.note: Ramps down INTO the shop; run is the floor measurement, not the slope
ramps.offsetComment: 14'-7" off the left corner of the left end wall (which is now the cut corner at 13' in): 9' of cinderblock notch plus the 5'-7" measured off the cinderblock wall.

tbd.frontGrade: is the apron at the bay door level with the slab?
tbd.cutCorner: what occupies the cut-out rear-left corner - the adjacent building?

cutouts.label: Rear-left corner not part of building

gradeComment: Site slopes: slab stands 49" above grade at the front wall (the man door and bay door are both at that height) and about 6" at the rear.

mezzanines.label: Mezzanine
mezzanines.note: 2x8 joists + 1/4" ply on 4x4 posts. Post spacing 6' assumed; stairs and railing not yet given.
